products.title: Submission Mastery: Omoplata by Giancarlo Bodoni
products.body:
Giancarlo Bodoni — 2x ADCC champion, CJI standout, and elite New Wave athlete under the legendary John Danaher and Gordon Ryan — unveils his groundbreaking system for mastering one of grappling’s most underutilized weapons: the omoplata.

  • This is not just a submission tutorial. This is a total redefinition of the omoplata for the modern no-gi game — built on elite-level mechanics, control, and finishing options that go far beyond what you thought possible.
  • Whether you’re a competitor looking to level up your submission rate or a hobbyist wanting a reliable position to control and finish from, this instructional will change how you approach the omoplata — forever.

  • The Most Advanced Omoplata System Ever Filmed – Designed for modern no-gi application at the highest level of competition.




Check Out a Free Sample:

What Will You Learn?

Giancarlo Bodoni — 2x ADCC champion, CJI standout, and elite New Wave athlete under the legendary John Danaher and Gordon Ryan — unveils his groundbreaking system for mastering one of grappling’s most underutilized weapons: the omoplata.

This is not just a submission tutorial. This is a total redefinition of the omoplata for the modern no-gi game — built on elite-level mechanics, control, and finishing options that go far beyond what you thought possible. Whether you’re a competitor looking to level up your submission rate or a hobbyist wanting a reliable position to control and finish from, this instructional will change how you approach the omoplata — forever.

🔥 Inside This Groundbreaking Series:

  • The Most Advanced Omoplata System Ever Filmed – Designed for modern no-gi application at the highest level of competition.

  • Multiple Finishing Pathways – Learn how to secure the tap even against elite-level resistance, including turning finishes, back takes, rolling finishes, and transitions into leg locks or other submissions.

  • Setups from Everywhere – Guard, scrambles, passing reactions — Bodoni shows you how to consistently enter the omoplata from every situation.

  • Positional Control Over Submission Desperation – Discover how to use the omoplata as a dominant position to break down even the most explosive opponents.

  • Giancarlo’s Proven Competition Mechanics – Learn the exact grips, angles, and pressure details that helped Bodoni dominate at CJI and ADCC.

  • Conceptual Deep Dives – Go beyond moves and understand the “why” behind every control, adjustment, and reaction.

Whether you're a beginner looking to add a powerful submission to your arsenal or a black belt seeking cutting-edge innovation, Submission Mastery: Omoplata delivers the tools to evolve your entire game.

Master the move. Control the position. Finish the fight.
With Giancarlo Bodoni, the omoplata isn’t just back — it’s better than ever.

products.title: Forging The Guard: Mastering The Foundations of Closed Guard by Giancarlo Bodoni
products.body:
ADCC Champion Giancarlo Bodoni Is Here To Revolutionize Your Closed Guard With A Modern Approach To A Classic Position!

  • Closed guard is an essential position that can be overlooked or classified as a “beginner position”, Giancarlo sets the record straight with a complete closed guard system that anyone can add to their game!
  • Discover next level concepts that allow you exploit the advantages of closed guard, including conserving energy, slowing aggressive opponents down, and potent offensive potential.
  • Put yourself in scenarios where you are able to predict your opponent's movements and capitalize with a wide range of high-percentage submissions, sweeps, and back takes!
  • Develop go-to attacks for when opponents look to stand and split your guard.
  • Overwhelm opponents with sequential attacks that take advantage of common defensive reactions like stacking or utilizing a figure 4 defense from armbar scenarios.
  • Round out your offense and bridge the gap between failed attacks and entering the legs with razor-sharp entries from failed triangles, armbars, and omoplatas.
  • Create a world-class closed guard under the expert guidance from ADCC Champ Giancarlo Bodoni and his 4-part masterclass on Efficiently Executing From Closed Guard!

products.title: Automatic Omoplata System by Clark Gracie
products.body:
Master the OMOPLATA--the submission that can be your new favorite position.

  • You might not look like Clark Gracie, but your omoplatas will be the best-looking part of your game.
  • SWEEP them when they’re defending the SUBMISSION and SUBMIT them when they’re defending the SWEEP.
  • Chain OMOPLATAS to ARMBARS and TRIANGLES to keep your opponents guessing.



Master the OMOPLATA--the submission that can be your new favorite position.

Attack this powerful shoulder lock from every possible position and angle.

Check Out The Trailer To This Series!

What Will You Learn?

Clark Gracie is famous for two things--dashing good looks and high percentage omoplatas. He’s here to help you with one of them--and it may not help you get Tinder swipes but it will definitely get you the taps.
Attack this powerful shoulder lock from every possible position and angle. Combine it into a triple threat with the triangle and armbar--for a recipe for guaranteed victory. Keep them guessing with OMOPLATA SWEEP setups that will keep them on the defensive.
Make your omoplata percentage go viral with the addition of these tricky set ups to your game. Sweep their breath away with these ridiculously good looking techniques.

This four volume series covers basic OMOPLATA CONCEPTS all the way to those fancy LASSO GUARD set ups and everything in between. Snatch the shoulder and never miss another finish by letting them roll out with Clark Gracie’s omoplata formula.

So, What's On This Series?
